nodes.label: D0 No Crashes
nodes.rationale: Most important directive; wins every conflict. Safer implementation chosen over faster/prettier.

nodes.label: D1 Optimization
nodes.rationale: Zero heap allocations in hot paths; visuals client-only.

nodes.label: D2 Co-op Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Server decides NPC/world/random outcomes; owner-only player projectiles.

nodes.label: D3 Balance
nodes.rationale: Every stat against a same-tier vanilla anchor, +/-15% effective DPS.

nodes.label: D4 Pixel Art
nodes.rationale: 1x drawn, 2x nearest-neighbor export, Cogpunk palette, top-left light.

nodes.label: D5 Visual Proof GIF
nodes.rationale: Animated changes need a GIF from frames or simulation; in-game capture not required.

nodes.label: Vanilla Limits
nodes.rationale: Verified by decompiling tModLoader v2026.08.3.0 with ilspycmd

nodes.label: SafeSpawn
nodes.rationale: Validates type ids/NaN, refuses instead of overwriting, keeps reserve slots for vanilla

nodes.label: SafeLog
nodes.rationale: Reports each key at most 3 times to prevent console loops

nodes.label: CogpunkPacket
nodes.rationale: Receive validates every index

nodes.label: PacketRegistry
nodes.rationale: Catches exceptions and drops packet

nodes.label: SafeGenPass
nodes.rationale: Catches exceptions so world creation continues

nodes.label: Core Templates Bases
nodes.rationale: Missing-texture fallback so missing art never blocks loading

nodes.label: WorldFlagSystem
nodes.rationale: Saves flags by name, syncs on WorldData

nodes.label: Expert-first Balance
nodes.rationale: User directive 2026-10-27: every number is the Expert value; Classic half, Master 1.5x via vanilla ratios

nodes.label: BossBag Expert-only Drops
nodes.rationale: Bags drop only Expert/Master; per-player instanced loot via playerInteraction

nodes.label: 4% Base Crit Rule
nodes.rationale: User rule 2026-10-23: leave Item.crit = 0; Generic supplies 4%

nodes.label: Attack-pattern Fairness
nodes.rationale: Telegraph >=30/20/12 ticks by tier; dodgeable; color-coded allegiance

nodes.label: Seamless Blocks
nodes.rationale: Tiles merge into one clump like vanilla ores; outline only on exposed sides

nodes.label: Art Direction for Detailed Entities
nodes.rationale: User rule 2026-10-26: three-quarter view, multiplane layers, death cinematics, Metal Slug detail

nodes.label: DepthLayers
nodes.rationale: Up to 3 parallax planes drawn in one SpriteBatch pass; poses rendered by generator, never rotated at runtime

nodes.label: Stable Pixels
nodes.rationale: User 2026-10-29: no colour flicker; part-space lighting, whole-pixel loops

nodes.label: Vanilla Detail Density
nodes.rationale: User 2026-11-05: Metal Slug level; long ramps, chibi proportions

nodes.label: Clear Outdated Proofs
nodes.rationale: User 2026-10-28: project size; delete docs/media proofs of old versions

nodes.label: Core and Content Architecture
nodes.rationale: Chosen 2026-10-20 after comparing Calamity, Starlight River and Spirit Reforged; feature-based slices, slices never depend on each other's internals

nodes.label: Mechanist Class and Steam
nodes.rationale: Steam works like mana (user-set 2026-10-27), not pressure build-up

nodes.label: StateMachineNPC
nodes.rationale: Owns ai[0] state and ai[1] timer, seals AI, recovers from NaN; ChangeState server-only

nodes.label: BossNPC
nodes.rationale: Scripted death: refuses killing blow, DyingState, StrikeInstantKill on server

nodes.label: Boss-fight Rules
nodes.rationale: User 2026-10-26: defeat card, no natural spawns, biome despawn, art-matched hitboxes

nodes.label: CogpunkInvasion
nodes.rationale: Re-implements vanilla goblin-army rules line for line

nodes.label: Fundamental Ruins
nodes.rationale: Metroidvania area (Hollow Knight inspired) from a text map; over a spider nest

nodes.label: Junkyard
nodes.rationale: Replaces left beach; reserves footprint so vanilla structures stay out

nodes.label: 1.4.5 Port Readiness
nodes.rationale: Prefer public hooks; IL edits/detours last resort in Core/Hooks
